'''Iso Shrine''' (いそじんじゃ) is a shrine enshrined in Iso-chō, {{ill|Ise, Mie|Q328067|qid=Q328067}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|Q128196|qid=Q128196}}. It is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and its former rank was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== History ===
In the 25th year of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|Q314850|qid=Q314850}}, while {{ill|Yamatohime-no-mikoto|Q4388732|qid=Q4388732}} was traveling provinces in search of a site for Amaterasu's grand shrine, she stayed at Iso-no-miya; this is said to be the shrine's founding. It is one of the shrines identified with so-called {{ill|Moto-Ise Shrines|Q11387775|qid=Q11387775}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Main deity: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amaterasu-sumasu-sumeramikami}}
* Side halls: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Toyouke-hime-ōkami}}・{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Konohanasakuya-hime no Kami}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=Iso Shrine official website|url=https://isojinja.com/|access-date=2025-12-5}}</ref>

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
* Kiyohama-sha（deity: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Utsushi-kunitama no Kami}}）
* Hakusan-sha（deity: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kikuri-hime no Kami}}）
* Yama-sha（deity: {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|abstract|Q386563|az|Ooyamatsimu|de|Ōyamatsumi|fa|اویاماتسومی|fr|Ōyamatsumi|hr|O-Yama-Tsu-mi|ja|オオヤマツミ|ko|오야마쓰미노카미|mni|ꯑꯣꯌꯃꯠꯁꯨꯃꯤ|ru|Ооямацуми|simple|Ōyamatsumi|sv|Ōyamatsumi|tr|Ōyamatsumi|zh|大山津見|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamatsumi no Kami}}）<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mie Prefecture Shrine Office: Iso Shrine|url=http://kyoka.mie-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/%e7%a3%af%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be/|access-date=2025-12-5}}</ref>
